import csv, hashlib, io, json, re, subprocess, sys, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
site = Path('products/sites/shopify-catalogue-example')
fixtures = site / 'fixtures'
original = fixtures / 'after-shopify.csv'
raw = original.read_bytes()
rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(raw.decode('utf-8'), newline='')))
headers = [re.sub(r'[^a-z]', '', name.lower()) for name in rows[0]]
sku_col, = [i for i, name in enumerate(headers) if name in {'sku', 'variantsku'}]
barcode_col, = [i for i, name in enumerate(headers) if name in {'barcode', 'variantbarcode'}]
pattern = re.compile(rb'(?<![0-9])[0-9]+(?![0-9])')
pair = None
for i, left in enumerate(rows[1:], 1):
    if not left[sku_col] or not left[barcode_col].isascii() or not left[barcode_col].isdigit():
        continue
    for right in rows[i+1:]:
        if not right[sku_col] or not right[barcode_col].isascii() or not right[barcode_col].isdigit() or left[barcode_col] == right[barcode_col]:
            continue
        values = [row[barcode_col].encode('ascii') for row in (left, right)]
        if all(sum(m.group() == value for m in pattern.finditer(raw)) == 1 for value in values):
            pair = (left, right, values)
            break
    if pair:
        break
assert pair, 'No two distinct fixture barcodes occur uniquely in the raw bytes'
left, right, values = pair
swaps = dict(zip(values, reversed(values)))
changed = pattern.sub(lambda m: swaps.get(m.group(), m.group()), raw)
changed_rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(changed.decode('utf-8'), newline='')))
assert len(rows) == len(changed_rows) and all(len(a) == len(b) for a, b in zip(rows, changed_rows))
differences = [{'sku': a[sku_col], 'before': before, 'after': after} for a, b in zip(rows[1:], changed_rows[1:]) for col, (before, after) in enumerate(zip(a, b)) if before != after and col == barcode_col]
assert len(differences) == 2 and rows[0] == changed_rows[0]
assert all(a[:barcode_col] + a[barcode_col+1:] == b[:barcode_col] + b[barcode_col+1:] for a, b in zip(rows, changed_rows))
entry = site / 'verify_example.py'
inputs = [entry, site / 'verify.py', fixtures / 'before-variants.csv', fixtures / 'before-images.csv', original]
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
    mutant = Path(temp) / original.name
    mutant.write_bytes(changed)
    runs = {}
    for label, path in [('baseline', original), ('barcode_swap_only', mutant)]:
        run = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(entry), *(str(p) for p in inputs[2:4]), str(path)], capture_output=True, text=True)
        runs[label] = {'exit': run.returncode, 'stdout': run.stdout, 'stderr': run.stderr, 'output_fixture_sha256': hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
expected = 'identifiers_preserved_sku_barcode_color_size_price'
try:
    baseline = json.loads(runs['baseline']['stdout'])
    mutated = json.loads(runs['barcode_swap_only']['stdout'])
    isolated = runs['baseline']['exit'] == 0 and baseline['failed'] == [] and runs['barcode_swap_only']['exit'] == 1 and mutated['failed'] == [expected]
except (ValueError, KeyError, TypeError):
    isolated = False
report = {'scope': 'Fictional offline control for the existing catalogue operator sample. The two barcode cells are the only parsed CSV changes. The row-level table is computed separately from verifier output.', 'isolated_grouped_failure_observed': isolated, 'separate_row_comparison': differences, 'source_sha256': {str(p): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in inputs}, 'runs': runs, 'limits': 'No live Shopify import, customer delivery, order or settlement was tested.'}
out = Path('products/services/stream-commerce-catalogue/delivery-rehearsal/director-barcode-only-control.json')
out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
out.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(out.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
